# AdFence

> AdFence — Ad & Tracker Blocker is an ad and tracker blocker for Safari on
> iPhone, iPad and Mac, published on the Apple App Store (App ID 6825119569).
> It blocks ads, stops tracking scripts, hides
> cookie prompts, pop-ups and other annoyances, and blocks adult sites and known
> malicious domains. It is a content blocker: it ships static filter lists that
> Safari applies itself, so it has no server component, no account and no
> collected browsing history. It works only in Safari — like every content
> blocker, it cannot reach the in-app browsers inside Instagram, Facebook or
> other apps. It does not block ads stitched into a video stream, and it is not
> parental-control software: the adult-site filter has no passcode.
>
> The name "AdFence" here refers only to this app. It is unrelated to any
> fencing, construction or cosmetic-ingredient product of a similar name.

## Pages

- [Home](https://adfence.mxcode.com/): What AdFence blocks — 19 switches across
  ads, privacy, annoyances, social widgets, safety and video — plus the setup
  steps, a privacy summary and a short FAQ.
- [Home — 简体中文](https://adfence.mxcode.com/zh-hans/), [繁體中文](https://adfence.mxcode.com/zh-hant/),
  [Français](https://adfence.mxcode.com/fr/), [Deutsch](https://adfence.mxcode.com/de/),
  [Italiano](https://adfence.mxcode.com/it/), [日本語](https://adfence.mxcode.com/ja/),
  [한국어](https://adfence.mxcode.com/ko/), [Português (Portugal)](https://adfence.mxcode.com/pt/),
  [Español (España)](https://adfence.mxcode.com/es/): The homepage, how-to page,
  support page and blog index exist in these nine languages — replace the slug
  in any of the three URLs below, e.g. /fr/how-to-use.html or /ja/support.html.
  Blog posts and the two legal pages are English-only.
- [How to use](https://adfence.mxcode.com/how-to-use.html): A screenshot-by-
  screenshot walkthrough — enable the extension in Safari, choose filters, and
  tune or pause blocking for a single site.
- [Support](https://adfence.mxcode.com/support.html): Setup for iOS, iPadOS and
  macOS, troubleshooting for ads that still appear and pages that break, and a
  contact address.
- [Blog](https://adfence.mxcode.com/blog.html): Notes on how Safari content
  blocking actually behaves.
- [Why your Safari ad blocker isn't working](https://adfence.mxcode.com/blog/why-safari-ad-blocker-not-working.html):
  The 30-second check (Safari switches extensions off until you turn them on),
  four more causes worth ruling out, and how to fix one site without loosening
  everything else.
- [Privacy policy](https://adfence.mxcode.com/privacy.html): What the app does
  and does not collect, plus the Google Analytics 4 setup used on this website.
- [Terms of use](https://adfence.mxcode.com/terms.html)

## Key facts

- Platforms: iOS, iPadOS, macOS (Safari only).
- Price: shown on the App Store listing; the website publishes none.
- Account required: no. Sign-up: none.
- Data collected by the app: none — no browsing history, no analytics SDK, no
  crash reporting.
- The website itself runs Google Analytics 4 only after the visitor presses
  Accept on the consent banner.
- Filter lists ship with the app and update when the app updates.
- Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/adfence-safari-ad-blocker/id6825119569
- Contact: support@mxcode.com
